# Current Panorama registrations retain native listeners

The original stub passes a stack Message into synchronous native callbacks and uses raw listener registrations. Current message publication uses a RefPtr<Message>, and MessageDatabase stores RefPtr<MessageListener> registrations, so registering a LiveView retains it. LiveView registers when it gains its one listener; ClearListener clears that listener and removes the database registration. The test makes later mutations after clearing it. Preserve explicit release when notifications are no longer needed and do not carry the old raw-pointer/stack-message assumptions into current code. The inspected scopes do not establish every shutdown or reentrant callback path. This is static source and test-code inspection. Full Bugzilla and review timeline and inline discussion remains pending. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

Scope: Panorama native listener lifetime.
